# UPchieve Changelog, week of Aug 22 to Aug 29, 2026

*Generated by Claude from merge-request and commit activity. Details may be inaccurate; check the linked MR or ask the author.*

Last deploys: high-line Aug 28, subway Aug 27. These deploys carried the async essay review, dependency, and CSP work that last week's digest had as merged, approved, or in review.

**Status key:** 🚀 Launched (live to everyone) | 🧪 Experimental (in production, behind a feature flag) | 🎁 Merged (ships next deploy) | ✅ Approved (reviewed, not yet merged) | 👀 In review (needs review)

---

## NTHS

The National Tutoring Honors Society, where a high school coach founds a chapter at their own school. Moving the president application out of a Google form and into the app, along with the school and chapter records behind it.

- 🚀 **Add "Complete the recruitment sprint" to the chapter onboarding checklist, and point the other items at where they happen.** "Attend orientation" became "Complete orientation" linking to nationaltutor.org/orientation, "Review UPchieve resources" became "Review NTHS resources" linking to nationaltutor.org/resources, and the Review NTHS Resources button beside the checklist moved off its Google Drive folder to the same page; clicking a link does not tick its box, since these checkboxes are one-way and that would mark orientation done the moment someone clicked through to start it ([high-line !1864](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1864)); the fourth action seeded into `nths_actions`, checked off for any chapter that already has `ATTENDED ORIENTATION`, since the sprint is explained in the new orientation and a president who sat through the old one would be asked for something they have never heard of ([subway !2890](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2890)); `RECRUITMENT SPRINT` added to the action-name union and to `GROUP_ADMIN_ACTIONS`, which guards the `/actions` endpoint and would otherwise reject the checkbox ([subway !2891](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2891)). *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Make a chapter official at three active members, and let it keep that status for the rest of the year.** The hourly impact-path job wanted six ready-to-coach members who had each done a session in the period, and it recomputed from scratch every hour, so a chapter that lost one member dropped back to PENDING. It counts three now, and returns early once a chapter is already OFFICIAL. The period it counts sessions over moved from Aug 2025 through May 2026 to Sep 1 through Dec 31, 2026. ([subway !2887](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2887)) *Kasozi Wilson*
- **Email a candidate when their application is approved or denied.** 🚀 a job running every 15 minutes that finds applications decided in the current period whose applicant has not had the status email yet, and a `sendBulkEmail` helper on `MailService` that hands SendGrid the whole batch in one call ([subway !2881](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2881), [subway !2880](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2880)); 🎁 the processor the scheduled job runs, which the first MR scheduled the job without ([subway !2892](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2892)). *Kasozi Wilson*
- 🚀 **Make NTHS card titles semi-bold.** The hardcoded `700` became the `$font-weight-bold` token, which is 600. ([high-line !1868](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1868)) *Ben Wheeler*
- **Instrument the chapter application funnel, to see where student coaches drop off, stall, or hit an error.** 🧪 eleven in-app events, covering the form opening, typing in the school search, picking a school or saying they cannot find one, finishing the school and grade step, going back from the questions, each question answered once on blur, the submit and its failure with the HTTP status, the pending page, and a blocked event carrying the server's ineligibility reasons for anyone redirected off an NTHS route ([high-line !1861](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1861)); 👀 the server side, returning the eligibility reasons the service already computes and firing approved and denied events when an admin decides an application in Retool ([subway !2884](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2884)). The application page itself is rolled out to no one yet ([`nths-application-page`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/593343)). *Ben Wheeler*
- 🎁 **Nudge a candidate who applied but has not founded their chapter.** Four SendGrid templates go out 3, 5, 8, and 12 days after their application was activated, and the query skips anyone who has already had that email or a later one in the same cohort, so a candidate who goes quiet for two weeks gets four nudges rather than one repeated. ([subway !2895](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2895)) *Kasozi Wilson*
- ✅ **Refuse an application from a coach who already has one.** Eligibility now also checks whether the coach is an active member of a chapter and whether they have ever applied before; either one makes them ineligible. Every NTHS surface routes through one destination function so the guards share the access logic, and changing occupation refreshes the store, since occupation decides eligibility. ([subway !2878](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2878); [high-line !1859](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1859)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 👀 **Decide NTHS candidate applications in bulk from the admin.** The approval endpoint takes several applications at once, and identifies them by application id instead of user id. ([subway !2888](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2888)) *Ben Wheeler*

## Student → Volunteer (S2V)

Lets a student become a volunteer coach on the same account, switching modes instead of creating a second one, so they can earn verified volunteer service hours.

- ✅ **Removed the `students-become-volunteers` feature flag and the "Become a tutor!" banner it gated.** The prototype flow has been switched off in PostHog for a while and the flow in use now runs on a different flag, so the header component, its getters, and the flag's payload copy all came out. ([high-line !1865](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1865)) *Jamie Kasulis*
- 👀 **Show a student-volunteer's last name on the admin user detail page.** `getUserForAdminDetail` blanked `last_name` for anyone with a `student_profile` row, and an account that adds the coach role keeps both profiles, so admins reviewing photo IDs saw a first name only and had to go back to the volunteer review list, which joins `volunteer_profiles` and selects the name unguarded. The mask now applies only to students with no volunteer profile, which keeps the original student-privacy intent for student-only accounts. [#716](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/716) ([subway !2894](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2894)) *Macy Lam*
- 👀 **Replace the "Type:" line on the admin user detail page with a chip per role.** The yellow "this student is part of an experiment" banner and the `(primary)` / `(experimental)` wording came out, now that student-volunteer accounts are launched rather than an experiment, and the chips render from `user.roles`, so a multi-role account shows all of them instead of one legacy `userType`. Colours reuse the existing `$c-volunteer`, `$c-student`, `$c-teacher`, and `$upchieve-green` tokens. ([high-line !1867](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1867)) *Macy Lam*

## Quick wins, fixes, chores, and other small things

- 🧪 **Coaches review the essays students send in, instead of staff.** Staff doing the reviews and hand-writing the email back took enough time that it capped how long the experiment could run, so the reviewing moves to coaches. A dashboard card takes a coach to a review page that lists submissions from the past 24 hours, takes up to six reviews per submission, thanks the coach and offers the next one, and posts to Slack through a PostHog webhook on every review so staff can spot a submission that has reached three ([high-line !1854](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1854)); the backend behind that page ([subway !2871](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2871)); the minimum review raised from 50 to 100 words, with a note recommending more, since longer reviews are usually better feedback ([high-line !1869](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1869)); an admin picking up to three coach reviews and emailing them to the student from a template instead of writing it by hand ([subway !2872](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2872), [high-line !1855](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1855)); an email to coaches when a student submits, linking straight to the review page, for coaches who opt in ([subway !2873](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2873)). The review page reaches everyone in the "Volunteers" cohort ([`volunteer-async-essay-review`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/844969)), the coach emails are rolled out to no one yet ([`volunteer-async-essay-review-email-notifications`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/844972)), and the student side of the submission reaches everyone in the "Students" cohort ([`async-essay-review`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/806269)). *Trey Stevens*
- 🧪 **Keep the coach's opt-in modal open until they answer it.** It closed on a click outside, which let a coach skip the question the experiment is asking, and its Back button did nothing on mobile. The Modal component took a prop to disable backdrop-close, the Back button calls `handleClose`, and the button spacing was tidied up. The opt-in reaches 20% of coaches ([`show-volunteer-opt-in-to-share-info`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/823424)). ([high-line !1856](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1856)) *Liseidy Bueno*
- **Screen image uploads with PhotoDNA before they are stored.** [#658](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/658): 🎁 the middleware, which checks a request body for an image file, sends it to PhotoDNA, and on a match quarantines it in a separate Azure container with the session id, upload kind, and user id recorded so the security team can report to NCMEC ([subway !2840](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2840)); 🎁 whiteboard and document-editor uploads moved to the backend, keeping their existing hosts, which also retired the `isUpdatedDocEditorImageStorageEnabled` flag that had been at 100% for a long time ([subway !2757](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2757), [high-line !1709](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1709)); 🎁 volunteer photo IDs uploaded through the backend too, checked against PhotoDNA but not moderated ([subway !2758](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2758), [high-line !1711](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1711)); 🎁 a `quarantined_on` column on moderation infractions ([subway !2807](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2807)); 🎁 the infraction's session id made nullable, since a quarantined volunteer photo ID does not come from a session ([subway !2832](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2832)); 🎁 the moderation-infraction reads moved from `makeRequired` to `makeSomeRequired`, which splits the migration and the code into separate MRs ([subway !2831](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2831)); ✅ assignment attachments converted to jpeg or png before they are submitted, since moderation and PhotoDNA only take those and we accept any image type ([high-line !1870](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1870)). Screenshares stay unscreened until rate limiting is worked out. *Liseidy Bueno*

### Fixes

- 🚀 **Start a session from a teacher's assignment.** "Start your session" dropped the student on the dashboard instead: `startSession` routes to `/session/<topic>/<subject>` when the assignment carries a `subjectName` and falls back to `/dashboard` when it does not, and `toAssigmentPublic` was not copying `subjectName` onto the public assignment. 🐛 [#708](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/708) ([subway !2886](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2886)) *Kasozi Wilson*
- 🚀 **Give a whiteboard image its own session flag when moderation catches something in it.** Image failures were pooled with the transcript reasons and run through `getSessionFlagByModerationReason`, which knows the transcript categories, so anything an image tripped came out as "General moderation concern" unless it happened to share a name. A whiteboard image failure now raises "Whiteboard Image Moderation Concern", keeping the session flag about where the concern is and leaving the reason to the moderation flag. A run of numbered `logger.warn` debugging calls came out with it. 🐛 [#673](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/673) ([subway !2885](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2885), [subway !2882](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2882)) *Kasozi Wilson*
- 🚀 **Stop pausing a student's account when a coach reports a safety concern.** Every report made in DMs triggers an automatic ban, which is deliberate, but "I am worried for the immediate safety of this student" is the exception we had missed, so the student someone was worried about got put under review. [#710](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/710) ([subway !2879](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2879)) *Jamie Kasulis*
- 🚀 **Tell a student their session ended without thanking them for picking it up.** Both sides got the coach's copy. `getSessionEndedMessage` picks by whether the viewer is the session's student. 🐛 [#699](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/699) ([high-line !1862](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1862)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Allow the dev photo-ID and session-photo buckets through the content security policy.** `dev-photo-ids` and `dev-session-photos` were added to `connect-src` and `img-src`, and the region-less `upc-*` bucket URLs came out of `img-src` in the report-only header, to confirm through reporting that every URL really does carry its region. ([high-line !1857](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1857)) *Alex Lindsay*
- 🚀 **Stop the test factories colliding on UNIQUE columns.** `test_database` failed intermittently on a unique-constraint violation raised by a factory rather than by the code under test. `student_partner_orgs.name` was filled from `faker.word.noun()`, a pool of 6660 words drawn six times, so the inserts collide about 1 run in 454; `users.email` collides 1 in 167 and school search 1 in 29. Two helpers build the name and the email off a UUID instead. ([subway !2876](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2876)) *Chris*
- 🧪 **Run a delayed session through the whole new-session flow when its timer expires.** The dashboard delay called `alertVolunteer` directly, which played the alert but skipped everything else `handleIncomingSessions` does, so a coach who let a delayed session pass was never moved from passive to inactive. The session is removed from the open list and pushed back through `handleIncomingSessions` now, so it arrives as if brand new. Only the coaches in the dashboard delay experiment have a delayed session at all: everyone in "Dogfood Eaters", plus 70% of coaches who are in both "Ready to coach" and "High-level subject certification (dashboard algo experiment)" and have been active since July 1 ([`dashboard-algorithm`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/798742)). ([high-line !1866](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1866)) *sammy nave*
- 🎁 **Stop the db-test database squatting on the e2e port, so the two suites can run at once.** `database-ci` published on 5500, which `postgres-e2e` also takes. It reads `DB_PORT` now and defaults to 5502, its fixed `container_name` is gone, and `jest.config.database.js` loads `.env` before `db-test-environment.js` resolves its own default, so `DB_PORT` decides which database the suite writes to. ([subway !2877](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2877)) *Ben Wheeler*
- ✅ **Pass the `EmailSessionReported` job the data it needs.** `processSessionEnded` queued it with the arguments in the wrong positions, so `sessionId` and `userId` arrived undefined and the job failed in `asString`. TypeScript missed it because `JSON.parse` returns `any`. The report data also stopped being written with an expiration, since it gets removed from the cache once it is used and `processSessionEnded` has run more than a day late before, which would have dropped the notification. ([subway !2874](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2874)) *Alex Lindsay*
- ✅ **Move secret scanning to push time and off `detect-secrets` on high-line.** The same four changes already approved on subway, split by commit to match: a version-controlled `.githooks` directory, Betterleaks behind the pre-commit and pre-push hooks, `secrets:check` moved onto pre-push, and a `bin/jj_pre_push` so jj users get the hooks too. ([high-line !1851](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1851)) *Alex Lindsay*
- 👀 **Close the photo ID modal when a volunteer taps back.** Two bugs with the same repro. The mobile back link was wired to the backdrop-click handler, which only fires when the click target is the raw overlay div, so clicking the arrow or the text did nothing, in every modal in the app that renders one. And `PhotoUploadModal` is a plain `v-if` rather than a route, so the browser's own back button had nothing to intercept and navigated off the dashboard; it pushes a dummy history entry on mount and closes on `popstate` now, matching the "x". 🐛 [#641](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/641) ([high-line !1758](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1758)) *Macy Lam*

### Internal tools

- 🎁 **Show one copy of a post-session survey answer in the admin.** The "Your thoughts" text appeared twice for both students and coaches, because the questions are shared between two surveys and the query walked every survey attached to the session's subject. It joins on the survey context id too now, so only the survey the person actually answered comes back. 🐛 [#709](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/709) ([subway !2889](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2889)) *Liseidy Bueno*
